troll_tos_header:
⚠️ **Heads up — this might break Discord's rules.**
Before this goes out, here is what looks risky:
troll_tos_footer: Discord can disable accounts and apps over this (including this app), and server AutoMod or moderators may act on **you**. This is only a warning — it's your call. If you're unsure, don't post it. ([Community Guidelines](<https://discord.com/guidelines>))
troll_tos_mass_ping: • **Mass ping** — `@everyone` / `@here` / a role ping notifies lots of people who didn't ask for it (spam).
troll_tos_many_mentions: • **Many users pinged at once** — notifying this many people can count as unsolicited bulk messages (spam).
troll_tos_spam_repeat: • **Repeated lines** — flooding a chat with repeated text is spam / platform manipulation.
troll_tos_tts_spam: • **Text-to-speech flood** — repeated or mass-pinged TTS reads out loud over people's calls and games.
troll_tos_rapid_use: • **Lots of posts in a short time** — this many messages in a few minutes looks like spam.
troll_tos_threat: • **Threat** — threatening to hurt someone is not allowed (Bullying, Harassment & Threats policy), and may be reported to the authorities.
troll_tos_self_harm: • **Encouraging self-harm** — telling someone to hurt or kill themselves is not allowed (harassment / self-harm policies).
troll_tos_ip_address: • **An IP address** — posting someone's address or personal details (doxxing) is not allowed.
troll_tos_personal_info: • **Personal information** — phone numbers, emails or doxxing/DDoS/swatting talk. Don't post other people's private details.
troll_tos_scam: • **Scam / phishing wording** — fake Nitro or gift offers, "verify your account" and password/token requests are scams (Developer Policy: financial scams, credentials).
troll_tos_ip_logger: • **IP-grabbing link** — that link goes to a site that logs the IP address of whoever clicks it.
troll_tos_lookalike_link: • **Fake-Discord link** — a look-alike of Discord's address, the classic phishing trick.
troll_tos_short_link: • **Shortened link** — hides where it really goes; often used for scams (not a problem by itself).
troll_tos_invite_link: • **Server invite** — unsolicited invites are treated as advertising / spam (not a problem by itself).
troll_tos_impersonation: • **Looks like Discord or its staff** — impersonating Discord, its staff or its services is not allowed (Developer Policy / Identity & Authenticity).
troll_tos_hate_term: • **A flagged term** — a word on this bot's block-list (hateful or abusive language is not allowed: Hateful Conduct / Harassment policies).
troll_tos_risky_file: • **Risky file** — programs and scripts (.exe, .bat, .js …) or a disguised file name can carry malware.
